markets.about: Ontario Saturday Market is a farmer/crafter market featuring local vendors with fresh produce, flowers, preserves, baked goods, handmade crafts, artisans, and more from both Oregon and Idaho. We accept SNAP, WIC and Senior Farm Direct, Veggie Rx, and provide Double Up Food Bucks
